articles.summary: Oliva was self-admittedly the “average” high schooler in Avon, OH. She wasn’t remarkable, she thought, even though she’d long dreamed of space exploration. But to her, those ambitions belonged to “people born to be the next leaders” and she didn’t make that cut.
articles.title: And we have lift off! After self-discovery, this Peacock Scholar makes her ascent

articles.summary: For most people, earning a degree from Clemson University in mechanical engineering would be a pretty ambitious goal to reach, but Anthony “AJ” Garrett decided to add becoming a U.S. Marine in tandem with his degree to his docket.
articles.title: Clemson mechanical engineering grad steps off the graduation stage into U.S. Marine Corps
